basis.column_period: 1/(N_COLUMNS*f) with N_COLUMNS=1024 (A4: 全局最多一列有效)
basis.data_driver: channels_per_driver x I_PIXEL = 384 x 15 uA = 5.76 mA
basis.panel_average: equals the instantaneous scan-line current because exactly one column is always selected and no blanking current flows
basis.pixel_average: I_PIXEL x duty, duty = 1/1024 (D1 direction: average is DERIVED)
basis.scan_line_current: N_ROWS x I_PIXEL = 768 x 15 uA (scan electrode = one column)
